title: Brothers Henry, Willie 'Kaiser' and Nelson Joseph
summary: Joseph names his younger brother Henry, who played with Freddie Landry, and his brothers Willie (called Kaiser) and Nelson.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Willie Josephs You say Willie Josephs then was your brother. Is he a younger brother?

No, I have a younger brother who played music too in the country. Henry Josephs used to play with Phil Bonne William. Oh, yes. He played with Freddie Landry. I played with Freddie Landry. Freddie Landry played with Freddie Landry. After he got his own band.
And then your brother who died, what was his name? Willie Josephs. The other one?
Willie the other one, I'd better call him Kaiser. Yeah.
Why was he called Kaiser? I never did know.
Kaiser. And the one here, the barbush was Nelson Josephs.
And what did he play? Laramie. Oh, see.
